sources.name: OpenStreetMap way 970455277 footprint
sources.provider: OpenStreetMap (OSM contributors; source tags indicate Microsoft Building Footprints import)
sources.source_feature_id: way/970455277; nodes preserved in XML snapshot
sources.source_crs: WGS 84 / EPSG:4326, transformed to Purdue project local approximate XY
sources.method: Compared the original source asset ring to the OSM polygon; same parcel footprint. Local transform uses project convention X=(lon+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(40.4274°), Y=(lat-40.4274)*111040. Exact original asset ring match was within ~0.00002 m. Re-centered geometry by the polygon bounds midpoint; campus origin recorded separately.
sources.uncertainty: Not a survey; source polygon is a footprint approximation. Does not establish roof overhangs or vertical dimensions.

sources.name: Google Maps Street View panorama directly across from 242 S Grant
sources.source_date: March 2026 capture as shown by Google watermark/metadata
sources.source_crs: WGS 84 / EPSG:4326 pano camera location; not a survey position
sources.method: Downloaded the 1200x800 Street View panorama thumbnail at yaw 90° from the saved camera point. Camera is about 22 m west of the OSM parcel centroid on the Grant Street side and looks directly at the parcel facade. Matched the central 3-level house in the image to the OSM polygon/official 242 S Grant address and 2015 report corner. It visibly shows brick ground story, beige horizontal siding on two upper stories, dark shutters and a low-pitched dark hip roof.
sources.uncertainty: Google panorama is perspective imagery; no elevations or measured roof pitch. Adjacent buildings frame the view. Visual material/feature identification is strong; precise dimensions and unobserved side/rear elevations remain estimated.

model.interior: Estimated garage support/parking, two residential levels, shared kitchen/dining/lounge/study furniture, and 15 bedroom bays; floor plan and furniture layout are not sourced drawings.
model.roof: Two shallow dark hip roof volumes over the L-shaped wings; separate geometry keeps the documented northeast terrace notch open. Roof pitch and exact ridge layout are estimated from Street View.
model.validation: Fresh-opened in Blender 5.2.3 LTS; required scene/collection, 1780 mesh objects, and 14 materials verified; three new inspection renders saved.
model.street_view_correction: R1 correction applied: lower street frontage is brick with a grade-level centered entry and three flanking windows; both residential levels use beige horizontal lap siding; four front windows per floor have dark burgundy louvered shutters; former upper-front entry and elevated stairs/landing removed; replaced broad flat roof with two adjoining low-pitched hip-roof volumes while retaining the northeast terrace recess.

unresolved_uncertainties: Exact as-built elevations, roof ridge layout/pitch, facade/window schedule, and interior plans were not found.
The city staff report is a July 9, 2015 planning report, not an as-built survey. Contractor-reported floor area does not reconcile neatly with footprint times floor count.
Street View directly verifies the Grant-facing exterior appearance; beige siding and shutters were extrapolated around unobserved side/rear upper facades.
Interior partitions and room layouts remain plausible estimates, not surveyed drawings.
